en: The postcard shows a black and white photograph of a grand building labeled 'KURTHEATER'. The building is adorned with classical columns and features a sculpted coat of arms above the entrance. Well-maintained gardens and sculpted bushes surround the entrance, and tall trees provide shade. A horse-drawn carriage is visible on the right side. The bottom of the postcard has printed text reading 'Bad Elster — Kurtheater'.
